name: Schlossbraustüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**The Schlossbraustüberl in Schwangau** – a cozy, historic beer garden right at the foot of **Neuschwanstein Castle**, where you can enjoy traditional Bavarian dishes like **Obatzda**, **Schweinshaxe**, and **Kaiserschmarrn** alongside a refreshing **Tiroler Bier** or a glass of **Grüner Veltliner**. The rustic wooden interiors and lively atmosphere make it the perfect spot for a hearty meal after exploring the fairy-tale castles of **Schwangau**. Try their famous **Schlossbraustüberl** beer—brewed on-site—and savor the view of **Marienbrücke** in the distance. Open year-round, it’s a must-visit for food lovers and castle enthusiasts alike. --- **

Opening Hours

** Daily: **10:00 AM – 10:00 PM** (last orders at **9:30 PM**) **

Location

** Schlossbraustüberl **Schwangau**, near **Neuschwanstein Castle** **www.schlossbraustueberl.de**
